description: This file defines the MessagingTrace class, which implements diagnostic reporting and logging for messaging events within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It provides methods for logging specific messaging events, such as message creation, sending, reception, dropping, enqueuing, dequeuing, scheduling, and rejection, integrating with ILogger and DiagnosticListener frameworks.

classes.name: MessagingTrace
classes.description: A class that handles diagnostic and logging for messaging-related events within Orleans, implementing DiagnosticListener and ILogger, providing methods to log various message lifecycle events.

methods.name: OnSendMessage
methods.description: Logs the event of sending a message if enabled.

methods.name: OnIncomingMessageAgentReceiveMessage
methods.description: Logs and processes the reception of a message by the incoming message agent.

methods.name: OnDispatcherReceiveMessage
methods.description: Logs and processes the reception of a message by the dispatcher.

methods.name: OnDropExpiredMessage
methods.description: Logs and processes the dropping of an expired message at a specific phase.

methods.name: OnDropBlockedApplicationMessage
methods.description: Logs and processes the dropping of a message due to application message blocking.

methods.name: OnSiloDropSendingMessage
methods.description: Logs and processes the dropping of a sent message from a silo, providing reason.

methods.name: OnEnqueueInboundMessage
methods.description: Logs the enqueueing of an inbound message.

methods.name: OnDequeueInboundMessage
methods.description: Logs the dequeueing of an inbound message.

methods.name: OnCreateMessage
methods.description: Logs the creation of a message.

methods.name: OnEnqueueMessageOnActivation
methods.description: Logs the event of enqueueing a message on activation and instruments the process.

methods.name: OnInvokeMessage
methods.description: Logs the invocation of a message.

methods.name: OnRejectSendMessageToDeadSilo
methods.description: Logs the rejection of sending a message to a dead silo.

methods.name: OnSendRequest
methods.description: Logs sending a request message internally.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Begins a logical scope for logging.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specified log level is enabled.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with provided level, event, state, exception, and formatter.
